verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both have the same flaws. The PlayStation-style symbols are jammed against the top edge. The headline block crowds the bottom edge and nearly touches the right column. The pink subhead breaks into ragged lines with orphans ('YOU CANNOT', 'VIRTUAL'). The 3-day event detail text is shrunk until it can't be read, while the URL is larger than the copy it supports, so the hierarchy is broken.
